messages:
Maya (CS Ops): heads-up: noticed ~120 trials had healthscore suddenly drop to 0 after last CRM import. likely metadata mapping issue. tagging @Riley @Sam :thumbsdown:
Riley (Data Eng): on it — can you paste a few example account ids and the query you ran?
Maya (CS Ops): sample ids: ACC-78912 ACC-78931 ACC-79000
Maya (CS Ops): query I ran:
```sql
SELECT account_id, onboarding_status, contact_count, healthscore
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE updated_at > '2026-03-19'
AND account_id IN ('ACC-78912','ACC-78931','ACC-79000');
```
Sam (CS Tools): I think the import transform we pushed last week might be the culprit — mapping rule for onboarding_status -> if contact_count=0 we were setting "needs_setup" but there was an edge case for NULL. I'll check mapping diff.
Deploy Bot: Importer v3.4 deployed to prod at 2026-03-20T09:12:03Z — success
Eli (Success Manager): we have ~57 active trials in that cohort due for renewal in 30-60 days — this will spike renewal risk signals. should we pause automation that triggers churn outreach?
Maya (CS Ops): paused automation: trial_churn_alerts for that segment. can CS leads hold outreach until fix is confirmed?
Riley (Data Eng): confirmed root cause: transform step nulls onboarding_status when contact_count IS NULL because coalesce wasn't applied. preparing quick patch.
Riley (Data Eng): temp backfill sql to run post-patch:
```sql
UPDATE crm.accounts
SET onboarding_status = COALESCE(onboarding_status, 'unknown'),
    healthscore = GREATEST(healthscore, 10)
WHERE updated_at > '2026-03-19'
AND contact_count IS NULL;
```
Sam (CS Tools): will rollback the mapping change in staging and run the backfill once Riley patches. ETA ~45m. I'll post runbook snippet and job id.
Maya (CS Ops): thanks — I'll update the cohort dashboard and send a short note to SAs to hold any automated follow-ups. @Eli tag any VIPs that need manual outreach.
Eli (Success Manager): flagged VIP ACC-78931 — I'll reach out manually.
Deploy Bot: Backfill job queued (job id: 0x4f2)
Sam (CS Tools): update: staging rollback completed, running backfill in prod now. logs -> https://logs.internal/runs/0x4f2 (will post success when done)
Maya (CS Ops): quick check shows healthscores restored for 118 accounts so far. keeping automation paused until 09:00 tomorrow to monitor. :white_check_mark:
Sam (CS Tools): backfill finished, run time 22m, no errors. pushed patch to transform with coalesce fix.
Riley (Data Eng): confirmed metrics look normal — rolling 24h monitor on healthscore distribution.
Maya (CS Ops): closing loop: cohort health restored, manual outreach done for VIP, automation re-enabled 2026-03-21 09:00. thanks team! :tada:
